newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta government to wind up postal company.
newsitem.headline: Malta government to wind up postal company.

text.p: The Maltese government is to appoint a liquidator to wind up Posta Ltd, the wholly-owned government company responsible for all postal services on the island.
Transport and Telecommunications Minister Joe Debono Grech told parliament late on Wednesday it would be liquidated "because it is in a state of insolvency".
He said the old department of posts would be reconstituted and the acting postmaster general had been told to take responsibility for the continuation of the service.

The minister referred to four reports on the working of Posta Ltd, one of which showed that there was "gross mismanagement" and that it had lost over one million Maltese pounds ($2.6 million) in bulk mailing contracts with Euromail Ltd of Germany.
He also revealed that land which Posta was to buy at Qormi for two million Maltese pounds to build new premises was now being offered for sale at half a million pounds.
